description: Add a segment to an existing Oh My Posh configuration with smart defaults. Automatically applies appropriate colors, templates, and options based on segment type.

blockIndex.description: The index of the block to add the segment to (default: 0)

config.description: The existing Oh My Posh configuration as JSON string

segmentType.description: The type of segment to add (e.g., "git", "python", "aws")

template.description: Optional custom template for the segment

name: add_segment
